name: Joram (son of Ahab)
title: King of Israel, killed by Jehu
summary: Joram was the son of Ahab and king of Israel after his brother Ahaziah. He waged war against Moab and Aram, but was killed by Jehu at Jezreel, bringing an end to the house of Ahab as the prophets had foretold.

keyEvents.title: Killed by Jehu at Jezreel
keyEvents.description: Jehu, anointed king to destroy the house of Ahab, shot Joram through the heart and threw his body onto Naboth's field in Jezreel.
